summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 1, 2026, announcing signed contracts with an international customer valued at approximately $270 million for advanced ISR Targeting payloads from its SPECTRO family. The contracts are to be performed over up to six years. This is an ordinary commercial contract announcement, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. There are no deal terms in the filing. The filing simply discloses a routine business development win, so it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
